description: A contract that exists to exercise the generated runtime stubs.

It has one op of each shape the generator has to handle differently: arguments and a result, arguments and no result, no arguments at all, and a stream. Every one of them is wired by the generated registration and called through the generated client, over a loopback peer, so that what is asserted is the running code rather than the tokens.

fields.name: name
description: The name to put in the greeting.

types.name: CountArgs
description: How many items to put on the stream.

fields.name: upto
description: The number of items to emit, starting at zero.

types.name: Tick
description: One item on the count stream.

types.name: Tally
description: What the producer has seen so far.

fields.name: greeted
description: How many greetings it has answered.

types.name: Fault
description: What went wrong, in a form a caller can branch on.

errors.name: demo_host
description: Something a producer of this contract could not do.

ops.name: demo.host.greet
description: Greet somebody. Arguments and a result, which is the ordinary case.

ops.name: demo.host.forget
description: Forget somebody. Answers nothing at all, which is a shape in its own right and not a result that is sometimes absent.

ops.name: demo.host.tally
description: How many greetings have been answered. Takes no arguments, which still travels as an empty object because peerline refuses params that are not one.

ops.name: demo.host.count
description: Emit one item per number, then stop. The op whose kind a hand-written registration gets wrong.
